name: Red Skull

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Zırhı aktifken bloğuna vurmak sana doğrudan hasar verir. Nötralize'ye immün, mistik counterlar işe yaramaz. Her aktif zırh, sersemletme siper hassasiyetini azaltır (siperlemek zor). E1'de 3sn otomatik blok, E2'de durdurulamaz olur. Zırh kıran şampiyonlar en etkili; Knull da zırhlarını debuff'a çevirdiği için iyi seçenek.
signatureAbility:
Cube Affinity
While charging a Heavy Attack, generate [3 - 7.5]% Power per second and Red Skull's Heavy Attack can be charged for an extended duration.
Every 10th Basic Attack grants Red Skull 1 Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Red Skull is Immune to Nullify, Fate Seal, and Stagger effects from Champions.
Against Mutants, Red Skull's Ability Accuracy cannot be modified.

abilitySections.title: Armor Up - Max: 10
content: Start each fight with 5 indefinite Armor Up Buffs, each increasing Armor Rating by [305.56].
When either Champion fills a Bar of Power, gain 1 Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Overwhelming Presence - Passive
content: For each Armor Up Buff, Red Skull gains the following bonuses:

abilitySections.title: Blocking a Basic Attack
content: Consume 1 Personal Armor Up Buff to Power Drain 10% of the Opponent's Max Power and deal [997.3] Direct Damage for each Armor Up Buff on Red Skull.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflict a non-stacking Heal Block Debuff for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain an Auto-Block Passive granting a 100% chance to Auto-Block Basic Attacks for 3 seconds. Duration is paused until the Special Attack ends, and is consumed when triggered. Auto-Block will not trigger while Red Skull is Unstoppable.
The first hit pauses all Shock Debuffs on the Opponent for 6 seconds.
Each hit deals a burst of [5,983.8] Energy Damage. Deal an additional burst of Energy Damage if the Opponent is suffering from a Shock Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain an Unstoppable Buff for 2 seconds, plus 0.5 seconds per Armor Up Buff on Red Skull. Duration is paused until the Special Attack ends, and is consumed when struck.
Each hit inflicts a Shock Debuff dealing [1,795.14] Energy Damage over 6 seconds, plus 1 second per Armor Up Buff on Red Skull.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Drain 100% of the Opponent's Power. For every 10% of Max Power Drained this way, gain an Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Cube Affinity
content: While charging a Heavy Attack, generate [3 - 7.5]% Power per second and Red Skull's Heavy Attack can be charged for an extended duration.
Every 10th Basic Attack grants Red Skull 1 Armor Up Buff.
